name: Hide Mind
source:
This is a story of a little bit future. Everything has been automated, and the world has been changed dramatically. As a result, people need more mental care than physical care. The patients who have serious mental problems are called Rank S, but there is no way to cure them. So they are isolated from other people. One day, a doctor appears, Itsuki. According to him, he can cure the Rank S patients. He is a psychiatrist and hypnotist, and uses hypnotism to cure them. One day, he receives a patient. Her name is Iori. Her parents ask him to remove her, and leave a large amount of money and her maid, Mayumi. Iori, Mayumi, Kana, his nurse, and Itsuki.... Will he be able to cure her...?

translation:
故事发生在不远的未来。一切都实现自动化，世界发生了翻天覆地的变化。因此，人们对心理照护的需求超过了身体照护。患有严重心理问题的病人被列为S级，却没有任何治疗方法，只能与他人隔离。一天，一名叫树的医生出现了。他声称自己能够治愈S级患者。身为精神科医生与催眠师，他使用催眠术进行治疗。一天，他接收了一名叫伊织的病人。她的父母要求医生除掉她，留下巨额金钱和她的女仆真由美后便离开。伊织、真由美、护士加奈，以及树……他能够治愈伊织吗……？
